impl_requirements: Emit a single .hip translation unit exposing a PYBIND11_MODULE with a forward() binding that launches the HIP kernel via hipLaunchKernelGGL or the chevron syntax; no host-side framework calls beyond the binding.
read_metric_guide: High dram_pct (MemUnitBusy) with low sm_pct (VALUBusy) => memory_bound. High VALUBusy with low MemUnitBusy => compute_bound. Low wavefront occupancy with neither saturated => latency_occupancy. Many short kernels / launch-dominated wall time => overhead_bound. Note that CU/SIMD asymmetry across GPU generations (MI200 dual-CU vs MI300 chiplet) means the same percentage can mean different things — see omniperf for richer attribution.

vectorized_load_store.prompt_guidance: Widen memory transactions to 128-bit by casting to float4/int4 (or use the AMD-specific global_load_lds intrinsics) so each thread moves 16 bytes per access.

memory_coalescing.prompt_guidance: Reorder the thread-to-element mapping so consecutive lanes in a wavefront read consecutive addresses; AMD wavefront=64 (gfx9/CDNA) or 32 (gfx10+/RDNA) — pick the right alignment.

shared_memory_tiling.prompt_guidance: Stage reused operands into a __shared__ (LDS) tile per block, sync, then compute from LDS to cut redundant global traffic. LDS is 64KB/CU on CDNA — size tiles accordingly.

async_copy_pipeline.prompt_guidance: On MI300 / gfx942 use direct global-to-LDS loads (buffer_load_dword to LDS) to overlap the next tile's global->LDS copy with current-tile compute, mirroring NVIDIA cp.async.

l2_cache_reuse.prompt_guidance: Block the iteration so hot operands stay L2/Infinity-Cache resident; on MI300X, exploit chiplet-aware workgroup swizzling for AID (Active Interposer Die) locality.

tensor_core_mma.prompt_guidance: Use MFMA intrinsics (e.g. __builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x16f16) for the inner GEMM with fp16/bf16 operands. CDNA = MFMA; RDNA3 = WMMA — pick the right ISA family.

instruction_reduction.prompt_guidance: Hoist invariants, replace divides/mods with shifts where legal, and #pragma unroll the inner loop to cut issued instructions.

fast_math_intrinsics.prompt_guidance: Where precision tolerance allows, use HIP intrinsics (__expf, __frsqrt_rn) and compile with -ffast-math / -ffp-contract=fast.

register_tiling.prompt_guidance: Accumulate an MxN micro-tile in VGPRs per thread to raise arithmetic intensity. CDNA: 512 VGPRs/SIMD — tile size is limited by this budget.

occupancy_increase.idiom: __launch_bounds__ / lower VGPR pressure to raise resident wavefronts
occupancy_increase.prompt_guidance: Annotate the kernel with __launch_bounds__ and shrink live state to fit more resident wavefronts per CU/SIMD.

block_size_tuning.idiom: sweep blockDim in multiples of wavefront size (64 on CDNA, 32 on RDNA)
block_size_tuning.prompt_guidance: Try block sizes that are multiples of the wavefront size (64 for MI300/CDNA, 32 for RDNA3) to balance occupancy against per-thread resources.

register_pressure_reduction.idiom: scope-narrowing / recompute to spill fewer VGPRs to scratch
register_pressure_reduction.prompt_guidance: Shorten variable lifetimes and prefer recompute over caching to drop VGPR count below the spill-to-scratch threshold.

launch_config_tuning.idiom: grid/block geometry and dynamic LDS sizing
launch_config_tuning.prompt_guidance: Tune gridDim/blockDim and dynamic __shared__ bytes so the launch geometry matches the CU count and tile shape.

kernel_fusion.idiom: fuse the elementwise epilogue into the main kernel
kernel_fusion.prompt_guidance: Avoid a second launch by computing the elementwise epilogue inside the producing kernel before the store.

launch_overhead_reduction.prompt_guidance: Collapse many tiny launches into a persistent kernel or a captured HIP graph (hipGraphLaunch) to amortize launch cost.

library_fallback_hybrid.idiom: delegate the hot GEMM to hipBLASLt / rocBLAS
library_fallback_hybrid.prompt_guidance: When a vendor library kernel dominates, call hipBLASLt or rocBLAS for the heavy op and keep custom code only for the glue. ARGUS targets ~99-104% of hipBLASLt/HipKittens throughput as the ceiling.

cpu_gpu_overlap.prompt_guidance: Split the work across HIP streams so host<->device copies overlap kernel execution.
